cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je získání přehledu o vzniku, čištění odpadních vod vznikajících v jednotlivých odvětvích potravinářského průmyslu, dále orientace v současných legislativních podkladech týkajících se odpadních vod z potravinářství a vodního hospodaření podniků.

en.label: Prerequisites:
en.content: Bachelor State Examination
Water management authorities and their competence - water in the landscape, legislation. (allowance 2/2)
Water management - groundwater and surface water, water abstraction, water treatment - principles, processes, equipment, operation, quality control, water storage and transport. (allowance 2/2)
Wastewater treatment - mechanical pre-treatment. (allowance 2/2)
Wastewater treatment - biological treatment - biological filtration, activation. Sludge management (allowance 2/2)
Water management of the food industry - water supply to industrial enterprises, water payments. (allowance 2/2)

Wastewater and process water in meat processing - generation of wastewater, specification of types of wastewater and process water, characteristics, expression of pollution, wastewater treatment, reduction of wastewater quantity and pollution. (allowance 2/2)

Waste and service waters from milk processing and dairy production - generation of waste waters, specification of types of waste and service waters, characteristics, expression of pollution, treatment of waste waters, reduction of quantity and pollution of waste waters. (allowance 2/2)

Wastewater and process water in potato processing - generation of wastewater, specification of types of wastewater and process water, characteristics, expression of pollution, treatment of wastewater, reduction of wastewater quantity and pollution. (allowance 2/2)

Waste and process water from sugar production - generation of waste water, specification of types of waste and process water, characteristics, expression of pollution, treatment of waste water, reduction of waste water quantity and pollution. (allowance 2/2)

Waste and operating water in beer production - waste water generation, specification of waste and operating water types, characteristics, pollution expression, waste water treatment, waste water quantity reduction and pollution. (allowance 2/2)

Waste and operating waters in cereal technology - generation of waste waters, specification of types of waste and operating waters, properties, pollution expression, waste water treatment, waste water quantity reduction and pollution. (allowance 2/2)

Waste and service waters in fermentation technology - generation of waste waters, specification of types of waste and service waters, properties, expression of pollution, treatment of waste waters, reduction of quantity and pollution of waste waters. (allowance 2/2)
Water management control of food processing plants - water management control. (allowance 2/2)
Water control of food processing plants - measurement and sampling, control profiles. (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of this course is to provide students a survey of methods of treatment oř wastewaters from individual branches of food industry and inform them about current legislation concerning this problem and water management of industrial plants and facilities.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Water management authorities and their competence - water in the landscape, legislation. (allowance 2/2)2.Water management - groundwater and surface water, water abstraction, water treatment - principles, processes, equipment, operation, quality control, water storage and transport. (allowance 2/2)3.Wastewater treatment - mechanical pre-treatment. (allowance 2/2)4.Wastewater treatment - biological treatment - biological filtration, activation. Sludge management (allowance 2/2)5.Water management of the food industry - water supply to industrial enterprises, water payments. (allowance 2/2)6.Wastewater and process water in meat processing - generation of wastewater, specification of types of wastewater and process water, characteristics, expression of pollution, wastewater treatment, reduction of wastewater quantity and pollution. (allowance 2/2)7.Waste and service waters from milk processing and dairy production - generation of waste waters, specification of types of waste and service waters, characteristics, expression of pollution, treatment of waste waters, reduction of quantity and pollution of waste waters. (allowance 2/2)8.Wastewater and process water in potato processing - generation of wastewater, specification of types of wastewater and process water, characteristics, expression of pollution, treatment of wastewater, reduction of wastewater quantity and pollution. (allowance 2/2)9.Waste and process water from sugar production - generation of waste water, specification of types of waste and process water, characteristics, expression of pollution, treatment of waste water, reduction of waste water quantity and pollution. (allowance 2/2)10.Waste and operating water in beer production - waste water generation, specification of waste and operating water types, characteristics, pollution expression, waste water treatment, waste water quantity reduction and pollution. (allowance 2/2)11.Waste and operating waters in cereal technology - generation of waste waters, specification of types of waste and operating waters, properties, pollution expression, waste water treatment, waste water quantity reduction and pollution. (allowance 2/2)12.Waste and service waters in fermentation technology - generation of waste waters, specification of types of waste and service waters, properties, expression of pollution, treatment of waste waters, reduction of quantity and pollution of waste waters. (allowance 2/2)13.Water management control of food processing plants - water management control. (allowance 2/2)14.Water control of food processing plants - measurement and sampling, control profiles. (allowance 2/2)
